verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy has a public REST API, so publishing a machine-readable spec is a fair axis for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths, llms.txt, and markdown docs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
